text:
Items: a glass of pale juice (likely pear or apple juice, ~250 ml), a rice paper roll (~100 g), two oat cookies (Anzac biscuits, ~25 g each), and a slice of toasted bread, possibly buttered (~50 g).

Energy estimates:
- Juice: 250 g, about 110 kcal
- Rice paper roll: 100 g, about 120 kcal
- Cookies: 2 × 25 g = 50 g, about 230 kcal
- Toast: 50 g, about 150 kcal

Total: about 610 kcal and 450 g. In the second photo everything is gone, so I counted all of it as eaten.
